parsed.why: Harshest tier: birth-sex facility statute, licence markers abolished 2026, teen name-change denial, RFRA service refusals, no state GI protections; national hate-crime prosecution (49-year sentence) is the lone mitigation.

2025 facility ban in state buildings, birth-certificate marker change foreclosed by state supreme court, care ban, 'worst for adults' rating; partial national backstop and a settled discrimination payout temper slightly.

No facility ban; minors-only care ban plus employee-care settlement and one city's surgery cancellation. City trans-women killings lack denominators—treated as background; mean regime moderately above parent.

Veto-overridden 2023 statute bundles school facility restriction and enforced minors' care ban with no phase-out; hate-crime law excludes gender identity, RFRA undermines recourse, but no adult-wide facility rule.

Hostile statutes enacted but reliably enjoined by state courts; care ban struck down, facility law restrained, marker changes blocked pending trial, flag/drag bans partly enjoined. Enforced parent regime plus judicial protection nets modestly above parent.
